news.title: Mizzou continues to rise in the U.S. News Best Colleges rankings
news.summary_en: Record student success and tremendous growth in breakthrough research fuel the university’s climb to a Top 100 national university.

news.title: At Mizzou, Skylar Ciccolini found a way to pursue every ambition
news.summary_en: Skylar Ciccolini came to Mizzou to compete as a Division I athlete. She found a passion for research, teaching and a future she hadn’t imagined.

news.title: Changing the way we age: Mizzou discovery could help preserve muscle strength
news.summary_en: W. David Arnold identified a breakdown in communication between nerves and muscles that could lead to new treatments for age-related weakness.

news.title: Mizzou research shows goats can help restore Missouri woodlands
news.summary_en: Gina Beebe, a University of Missouri doctoral student, is promoting a holistic view of land management that bridges the gap between conservation and agricultural production.

news.title: Mizzou plays critical role in one of the world’s biggest energy projects
news.summary_en: The University of Missouri Research Reactor has announced a partnership with Princeton Plasma Physics Laboratory to support the world’s largest fusion experiment.

news.title: University of Missouri celebrates 40-year South African partnership
news.summary_en: The University of Missouri System's relationship with the University of the Western Cape is a model for international collaboration in higher education.

news.title: Meet the Mizzou students who helped bring Memorial Stadium’s transformation to life
news.summary_en: The civil engineering majors gained real-world experience while helping with a landmark construction project that will welcome fans for years to come.

news.title: Neuro Bootcamp keeps participants active after neurological diagnosis
news.summary_en: The free program is offered through Mizzou’s Department of Physical Therapy.

news.title: UM System honors six faculty with Curators’ Distinguished Professorships
news.summary_en: The designation is the highest academic rank bestowed by the University of Missouri Board of Curators.

news.title: Mizzou alum turns family’s search for answers into action on rare disease
news.summary_en: John Ruth and his family are helping shape Mizzou’s new Center for Translational Neurogenetics.
